query: Update the feature map, we added two screens since last time.
setup: Flutter app with screens registered in lib/router.dart via GoRouter and state in lib/features/<name>/

No feature flag SDK is installed
expected_behavior: Reads the existing docs/feature-map.md and its meta comment before scanning the code

Adds the two new screens to the right capability sections and removes the deleted screen rather than regenerating the whole file from scratch
Preserves the manual block under Payments byte for byte
Updates the git sha in the meta comment
Reports no flags and writes `-` in the Flag column instead of inventing a flag mechanism
Summarises the diff to the user: added, removed, unchanged counts
